decision: Individually reviewed all six hunk paths. The production hunk replaces layout-coordinate reads with buttons/detail; the other five files update public test event defaults and fake-event setup. The authenticated16.2.14 reference already contains the final predicate. CDK22.1.7 exports the identical complete predicate and stable public MouseEvent-to-boolean signature. Genuine original and both minimum public exports execute without offsetX/offsetY reads, including zero-coordinate traps and short-circuit getter checks. The exact tagged owned menu handlers delegate to these exports and preserve fake-event origin, genuine mouse-button origin, submenu prevention and touch origin in44 cases per subject. Owned ripple helper imports remain under their existing separate reviewed renderer boundary. Current CDK owns focus-monitor/input-modality/drag-drop and its test helper; no CDK code is forked. This finite fix is inherited at the branch minimum; whole native focus, assistive-technology behavior and unrelated component routes are not certified.

prior_entry.subject: perf(cdk/a11y): Don't trigger re-layout when detecting fake mousedown (#28029)
prior_entry.reason: The patch changes isFakeMousedownFromScreenReader to test event.detail instead of offsetX and offsetY. That function is imported from @angular/cdk/a11y by the owned menu trigger and ripple renderer. It is not defined in this package, and the CDK body was not copied. Inherited via installed peer @angular/cdk@22.1.7 (advertised floor ^22.1.7); upstream SHA is an ancestor of v22.1.7.
